bannerLead: A legacy of welcome, carried forward for a new generation of Oregon's youth.
storyImageAlt: A warm, furnished living room inside Claudia House
storyTitle: Named for a mother who opened her door to every teen
storyBody1: Claudia was a social worker and mother who welcomed all teens — of any ethnicity, race, and religion — into her home. She and her spouse adopted three children of diverse backgrounds and gave shelter to many more teenagers during their formative years.
storyBody2: Claudia House continues that spirit of unconditional welcome as an Oregon nonprofit under Section 501(c)(3), serving educational and charitable purposes.
missionCardBody: To increase youth's behavioral, educational, and placement stability through short-term emergent care or longer-term care.
visionCardBody: Balanced growth across mental, physical, and spiritual dimensions — helping young people overcome obstacles and succeed.
commitmentIntro: Stable housing, life skills, and holistic support in an environment designed for comfort and care.
